name: hok_minimap_hd_bootstrap_dev
notes: Local development-only HD bootstrap candidate. Train uses reviewed video1+8+3+4+5 (534 crops / 981 boxes); video2-HD dev-val (100 crops / 197 boxes) was used for model and confidence selection, so results are same-match diagnostics, not an independent evaluation. At c=0.51 and NMS 0.5 the PyTorch checkpoint scored 174/13/23 TP/FP/FN (P/R/F1 93.0481%/88.3249%/90.6250%); recorded Android-equivalent ncnn detections scored 175/14/22 (92.5926%/88.8325%/90.6736%). Strict parity still fails: PyTorch-to-ONNX raw max error 0.002296686 (40/100 frames above 0.0005); TorchScript-to-ncnn raw max error 0.000997305 (3/100 frames above 0.0005); the Android-equivalent input pixel gate passes at max difference 1, but detection counts differ on 2/100 frames (187 vs 189 total) and max detection-value error is 0.724518 against a 0.01 limit. Keep verified=false and public defaults off.
